definition.description: Stand on a clean, level, non-slip surface with a correctly sized unweighted jump rope held in both hands. Rotate the rope with the hands and wrists so it passes under both feet once. Make one low simultaneous bilateral takeoff, clear the rope, and land quietly on both feet before the next pass. One rope revolution with one bilateral takeoff and landing is one repetition. Record valid passes, misses, actual contact count, cadence, rope type, surface, footwear, symptoms, and rest. Alternating-foot, boxer, single-leg, double-under, mimed, weighted-rope, high-output, interval, assessment, and other changed tasks require their own reviewed variant or definition.
